playstyle-desc-preset-roughseas: Standard survival on a world with open oceans, where wind, storms and the sea are dangerous.
worldattribute-bilgeWater-desc: Waves break aboard and rain falls into an open vessel, filling its bilge until you bail it out. Off, no wave or rain adds water; a leak still does, and a vessel awash or sunk still fills.
worldattribute-hullDamage-desc: Rocks, the shore, rams, rapids, breakers and the weather crack a hull, and a crack leaks. Hide rots, ungreased seams seep and reed soaks up water. Off, no hull takes harm and every hull is mended whole; a knock is still heard, and weapons and explosions still harm a hull.
worldattribute-stormLightning-desc: Storms strike lightning near you, and a mast draws it. Off, storms strike none of their own and masts draw none; the game's own thunderstorms are unchanged.
worldattribute-mooringStrain-desc: A mooring rope or an anchor's rode takes the pull of the water and the jerk of each wave: past its strength a rope parts, an anchor drags, and a vessel moored while you are away can be thrown ashore. Off, nothing parts, drags or is thrown; a rope still holds a vessel at its length.
worldattribute-oceanCurrents-desc: Currents carry every vessel, steered or not, and pull on its mooring. Off, the water carries no vessel; the currents still warm or cool the sea.
worldattribute-rowerFatigue-desc: Rowing, paddling and poling make you hungry. Off, they cost no satiety; a vessel still goes only as fast as you row it.
worldattribute-poleDepth-desc: A pole pushes only where it reaches the bottom. Off, it pushes in water of any depth as at its full stroke.
worldattribute-swimmerBreakers-desc: A wave that breaks over you while you swim pushes you under and along with it, and its foaming water holds you up less. Off, no wave breaks over a swimmer; you still float on the waves and breathe by them.
